title: The French mentality of New Orleans musicians
summary: Answering whether New Orleans men were thuggish, Butler says they have a French mentality, were superstitious, could be thuggish, but only the ones in music are known.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Well now, you told me one time that Bechet -- well, tell me this, how do you see the guys from New Orleans? Because I've had the impression before that most of them, or many of them, were kind of thuggish?

No. No, see, the guys -- this mentality is a different mentality. Because he has a French mentality. That was French influence. Thuggish, very superstitious, real capable of being thuggish, yes, indeed. But the ones you've met, you see, the ones we've met, we've met them in music. But there are some that are very religious. The only ones we know about are the ones in music. And they were around thugs.
